1.note: D-04 = RGBW (against the run recommendation, chosen knowingly). STR-REQ-01 amended to dual-mode. Strobe accepted as 802.3af-only. Light engine to be SPECIFIED not designed, now 4 channels. BLOCKING-01 owned by the coordinator: board_init --cutout flag being added centrally.

decisions.what: Design baseline = white-only (D-04 recommendation), pending human verdict at H1
decisions.why: Brief leans white-only; RGBW coloured blasts are already covered by 6-8 RGBW pars. Architecture is built white-only with an explicit RGBW delta documented, so a human 'RGBW' verdict costs a P2 revision not a restart.

decisions.what: BLOCKING-01: board_init.py cannot cut the mandatory 30x26 mm RJ45 notch (ICD s7.6)
decisions.why: board_swig.draw_outline emits only a rectangle (optionally corner-filleted) on Edge.Cuts; no script in the pipeline writes Edge.Cuts geometry after P5, and the playbook states the P5 outline is final. Surfaced at H1 with options.

decisions.what: P1 roster: 4 component-scouts (led-emitter, drive-stage, energy-store, protection-sense) + 1 reference-design (pulsed-led-driver) + power-architect. No research-interface-spec agent.
decisions.why: The only standards-bound interface is the expansion connector, and it is frozen and fully specified in brief/06-connector-icd.md (pin map, levels, currents, creepage). An interface-spec agent would only re-transcribe it.

decisions.what: BLOCKING-02: STR-REQ-01 (100-200 ms flash at FULL output) is unachievable at any bank size that fits
decisions.why: 0.99 J usable / 0.15 s = 6.6 W. Reaching ~92 W for 150 ms needs 13.8 J = 32,500-65,000 uF. energy-store scout measured 12,000 uF as 5,104 mm2 (64 pct of a 100x80 board) and 37 mm tall, and even that holds full output only 36.9 ms. Physics plus the closed 8.5 W budget, not a tooling limit.

decisions.what: Adopt connector ICD rev A2 (boards/lumina-carrier/architecture/connector-icd.md) as authoritative over the DRAFT-A copy in brief/06-connector-icd.md
decisions.why: Rev A2 adds s6.6 (binding bank-charging contract: current-limited soft-start, <=0.25 A af / <=0.5 A at, never >1.0 A for >162 ms, 3.2 J must land in the daughter limiter) and s8.4 (carrier guarantees 0 V at J3 when unprogrammed/crashed/brownout/reset), and raises board-wide 48 V outer-layer clearance from 0.60 to 0.635 mm.

decisions.what: 4-layer JLC04161H-3313; In1 AND In2 both solid GND (override planes_gen 4L default)
decisions.why: Thermal forces it: check_thermal 2L model floors at 55 C/W vs 4L 45 C/W, and the linear pass FET at 1.45 W in 56 C air fails P8 on 2L at any pour size. Supporting: 48 V routing needs 0.635 mm outer vs 0.127 mm inner, and the pulse loop return drops 1.53 mm -> 0.21 mm.

decisions.what: Operating point: 38.0 V string at 2.6 A, 39.7 V window floor, bank ceiling 44.5 V normal / 48.0 V armed
decisions.why: 38 V string reproduces the ICD s6.4 headline 0.99 J exactly while cutting board dissipation 2.33 -> 1.89 W (-19 pct) vs the 35.3 V alternative. The 44.5 V ceiling takes the pass FET from 1.03x its P8 thermal allowance to 1.77x margin at identical light output.

decisions.what: Charge limit 0.20 A flat current limit, not the ICD s6.6 ceiling of 0.25 A
decisions.why: 0.25 A x 48 V = 12.0 W instantaneous; plus the carrier's 2.4 W overhead that exceeds the 12.95 W 802.3af class envelope for far longer than the PSE 50-75 ms overload timer. 0.20 A satisfies s6.6's current-limited requirement literally and stays inside the class.

decisions.what: LED-short single-fault answer: ratiometric Vds comparator (drain vs 0.45x bank) + NTC in the pass FET's own pour, latched until ENABLE cycles
decisions.why: The current loop otherwise regulates 2.6 A into a shorted string, burning 125-148 W in the FET with no self-termination. A max-on-time one-shot was rejected as primary: it bounds one pulse but not the repetitive 9.9 W mean.

decisions.what: BLOCKING-03: 802.3at upgrade does not close thermally on this daughter
decisions.why: 4.67 W across two linear FETs in 69 C air; best case 1.91 W per D2PAK against a 1.40 W allowance = fails 1.5x. The at governor cap is ~12.1 W of 18.5 W = +45 pct light, not the +120 pct D-01 implies. A real at build needs an off-board or heatsinked pass element, i.e. a respin. D-01's 'resistor change, no respin' promise does not hold for LUM-DTR-STROBE-A.

decisions.what: D-04 CLOSED: RGBW, 4 colour channels
decisions.why: Project owner verdict at H1, knowingly against this run's white-only recommendation. Full costed delta (+$4-6 board BOM, +$40-80 LED module, all 8 PWM channels, no added light) was presented. Not to be re-litigated.

decisions.what: STR-REQ-01 AMENDED to dual-mode: headline 0.858 J / 98.8 W / 8.68 ms, plus a separate long mode (50 ms @ 28.1 W, 100 ms @ 18.2 W, 150 ms @ 14.9 W)
decisions.why: H1 verdict. The original 100-200 ms at full output needs 32,500-65,000 uF (BLOCKING-02) and is unreachable at any bank size that fits. Amended by decision and written into requirements.md with the original text quoted.

decisions.what: LUM-DTR-STROBE-A is 802.3af-ONLY. No board area or cost spent preserving an at path.
decisions.why: H1 verdict on BLOCKING-03. An at build fails the linear pass FETs by 1.5x in sealed-box air and buys only +45 pct light, not the +120 pct D-01 implies. The D-01 hedge still holds for the carrier and the par; this daughter is documented af-only.

decisions.what: D-04 CLOSED: RGBW, 4 colour channels
decisions.why: Project owner verdict at H1, knowingly against this run's white-only recommendation. Full costed delta was presented. Not to be re-litigated.

decisions.what: STR-REQ-01 AMENDED to dual-mode: headline 0.858 J / 98.8 W / 8.68 ms plus a long mode (50 ms @ 28.1 W, 100 ms @ 18.2 W, 150 ms @ 14.9 W)
decisions.why: H1 verdict. The original 100-200 ms at full output needs 32500-65000 uF (BLOCKING-02) and is unreachable at any bank size that fits. Written into requirements.md with the original text quoted.

decisions.what: LUM-DTR-STROBE-A is 802.3af-ONLY. No board area or cost spent preserving an at path.
decisions.why: H1 verdict on BLOCKING-03. An at build fails the linear pass FETs by 1.5x in sealed-box air and buys only +45 pct light. The D-01 hedge still holds for the carrier and the par.

decisions.what: CARRY: ICD s7.6 internal-air figures treated as PROVISIONAL (par run raised a blocking issue; 69 C at cannot coexist with 56 C af, independent calc gives 89-115 C)
decisions.why: This board's entire thermal case is built on 56 C (af) air. If real internal air is 85-90 C the pass-FET allowance collapses. Must be re-derived and reported at H2.

decisions.what: BLOCKING-01 RESOLVED centrally: board_init.py --cutout X,Y,W,H exists, tested, committed 18613d3. P5 invocation: --outline 100x80 --corner-radius 3 --mounting-holes 4 --cutout 6,0,30,26
decisions.why: Coordinator added the flag; both daughters need the notch. Cutout coords are relative to the outline top-left. Notch must touch an edge (ours does, y=0) and must not overlap a corner radius (x=6 clears r=3). Interior windows are refused (exit 2) because geom._parse_outline returns on the first gr_rect and would silently treat a window as the board outline.

decisions.what: P5 TRAP: read outline_origin from the board_init report, do not assume (0,0)
decisions.why: In fixed-outline mode the origin derives from the packed component bbox, so constraints.json keepout rects need translating into board space. Also verify corner_radius, cutouts and worker_notes, and confirm geom reads a non-empty outline of the expected area - a silent geometry failure reached P9 on the interior-window path.

decisions.what: Enclosure CLOSED: sealed non-metallic, LED heatsink bolted to/through the enclosure wall. Not vented.
decisions.why: Project owner; matches this run's Q6 recommendation and the par run's independent conclusion. Par measured 3.6-4.3 K/W internal-air-to-room, closing only because LED heat leaves through the wall rather than into the box. Both fixtures share one enclosure design; the wall-conduction path becomes an explicit LE acceptance criterion because this board's thermal case depends on it.

decisions.what: RGBW emitter selection rule: published thermal data beats optical convenience; zero pulsed headroom carried through to colour
decisions.why: Par run swept 318 RGBW emitter parts: every Cree XLamp colour line is zero stock, and the one in-stock RGBW 4-in-1 above 50 mA publishes neither Rth nor Tj max - the owner rejected it in favour of RGB 3-in-1 plus a separate white emitter. This board's light engine is OFF-BOARD and specified, so it is NOT bound to LCSC stock; distributor sourcing must be stated explicitly.

decisions.what: ICD s7.6 explained, not disputed: 56 C is the 'LED heat stays in the box' case
decisions.why: Applying the par's measured 3.6-4.3 K/W box figure to this fixture's two heat sources reproduces both disputed ICD numbers from one binary. Wall path works -> 1.894 W into the box -> 32-33 C at a 25 C room. Wall path fails -> 8.5 W -> 56-62 C, i.e. the ICD af figure to the degree. Design of record stays 56 C and the wall-conduction path is now a load-bearing dependency OF THIS BOARD, with worst-package margin 1.9-2.2x.

decisions.what: BLOCKING-04 (P3-OPEN-1): the hot-swap charge controller's fault TIMER cannot survive the 87 pct-duty current-limit regime on EITHER candidate
decisions.why: Datasheet-verified at P3: TPS2490 TIMER charges 25 uA / sinks 2.5 uA (10:1); LM5069 charges 85 uA / sinks 2.5 uA (34:1). At 87 pct duty in regulation the timer integrates positive to its 4 V threshold regardless of C_TIMER -> LM5069-2 auto-restarts at 0.5 pct duty (bank stops charging), LM5069-1/TPS2490 latch off. No controller in the class omits the timer. Needs an architecture answer, not a part swap.

decisions.what: BLOCKING-04 RESOLVED: charge path becomes a discrete timerless current limiter - ballast 2x39R 2512 + P-channel D2PAK + LM2904B half sensing across the ballast, ENABLE-gated, SOA covered by the NTC already in the pour
decisions.why: Break-even timer duty is 9.09 pct (TPS2490) / 2.86 pct (LM5069) against a design duty of 87 pct - no C_TIMER escapes it. Series-ballast-only (route a) rejected: the 25 Hz recharge swing (+/-0.045 A) is 1.6x the headroom (0.028 A), so the limiter re-enters regulation at any R. The ballast IS the sense element (3.9 V at the limit vs 3 mV offset). Dissipation re-splits 0.606 W into two 2512s / 0.215 W in the FET, deleting the charge FET from the 85-90 C failing set. BOM 20.53 -> 15.90 /board.

decisions.what: BLOCKING-05: IRF640NS datasheet does NOT state gate/drain/source pin assignment or the tab's electrical node
decisions.why: Both package outlines number leads 1/2/3 and stop; the only G/D/S labels are on the pinless schematic symbol. Extractor correctly refused to fill it from part-family memory. Four pass-FET placements ride on it. Must be resolved from an authoritative source (IR AN-994 / JEDEC TO-263AB / the pulled EasyEDA symbol) before P4 wiring.

decisions.what: MCP23008 and SN74LVC1G3157 kept as DOCUMENTED DERATINGS, not re-sourced
decisions.why: Datasheets contradict the sourcing rationale: MCP23008's -E +125 C grade is specified ONLY at Vdd 4.5-5.5 V (on +3V3 it is specified to +85 C); the UMW SN74LVC1G3157 is -40..+125 C in the PDF, not -55, and is characterised only to +85 C. Both are within abs max (unspecified, not destructive) and design-of-record ambient is 56 C, which the wall-path analysis showed is conservative. Re-sourcing would re-open the POR fail-safe analysis for a 1.14 USD saving on 6 boards. Reversible; recorded for H2.

decisions.what: IRF640NS SOA gap CLOSED by derivation: SOA is a pure thermal limit, no Spirito knee
decisions.why: All four published SOA lines satisfy P x Zth(j-c) = 150 C exactly against Fig 11, so the curve extends legitimately: ~151 W at 100 ms, ~150 W at 200 ms, landing on the 150 W Pd rating. Offsetting concern recorded: Fig 3 transfer curves cross at Vgs ~6.4 V / 24 A, so at 2.6 A the tempco is POSITIVE (current-hogging region) - single-die linear-mode thermal stability needs watching and paralleling pass FETs is unsafe.

decisions.what: BLOCKING-06 FIXED: strobe kicad lib tables pointed at the REPO ROOT lib/, not the board's own
decisions.why: fp-lib-table and sym-lib-table used ${KIPRJMOD}/../../../lib/ (repo root) where the carrier correctly uses ${KIPRJMOD}/../lib/. The first lib_pull created a stray untracked repo-root lib/ that other boards could collide with, while boards/lumina-strobe/lib stayed empty. URIs corrected, assets moved into the board's lib/, stray dir deleted.

decisions.what: ID_ADC code CLOSED by ICD s3.4 rev A3 (NORMATIVE): LUM-STR-A is code 1, R_ID = 2.7 kohm 1 pct
decisions.why: The P3 placeholder was 4.7 kohm - which is code 2, LUM-PAR-A. Left unfixed the strobe would have identified itself to carrier firmware as the RGBW par and loaded the wrong daughter profile. Adjacent-code separation is 0.353 V against +/-0.05 V of 1 pct divider error.

decisions.what: PWM timer concern DISSOLVED by ICD s3.5 rev A3 (NORMATIVE): the carrier does NOT hard-assign LEDC timers
decisions.why: The rev-A2 statement that PWM0-3 sit on timer 0 and PWM4-7 on timer 1 is withdrawn - the ICD says it was wrong for the strobe specifically. Each daughter declares its own channel->timer->frequency map in its design document and carrier firmware applies it from the ID_ADC code. The GPIO/RMT one-shot flash gate is explicitly legal. A 14-bit / 4.883 kHz opt-in mode is also now offered (CR-3 granted).

decisions.what: C:/Program Files/Git/OT_TRIP -> FAULT level translation VERIFIED against ICD s2 rev A6
decisions.why: ICD requires a daughter asserting FAULT to sink >= 5 mA (real load ~4.3 mA including the carrier's red fault LED, not the 0.33 mA the 10k pull-up alone implies). The added 2N7002 (Q404) is rated 115 mA continuous with Rds(on) ~1.2-2 ohm, so VOL at 5 mA is ~10 mV, and its 60 V Vds comfortably holds off a 3.3 V pull-up. Meets the ICD with large margin; the 12 V /OT_TRIP node never reaches the connector.

decisions.what: Design-of-record ambient moved to 70 C (ICD s7.7 rev A5 normative ceiling), NOT this fixture's computed 32-48 C
decisions.why: Designing to the published normative number rather than our own favourable computation. Worst package breaks even at 83.8 C = 13.8 K margin; even the wall-path-fails case (77 C) passes at 1.16x. Consequence: the P_rail governor caps are WITHDRAWN as operating constraints and kept only as contingency, returning 3-15 pct of the light. BANK_ARM momentary-only is now the board's sole thermal constraint. Cold start Tj 92-109 C against a 125 C design limit with the corrected 150 C Tjmax.

decisions.what: Timer map: 1 LEDC timer used, 3 free. 14-bit/4.883 kHz mode DECLINED.
decisions.why: Rev B budgeted two timers and left none; the actual map needs one. 14-bit declined with numbers: comparator offset dominates resolution by 47x, and restoring the doubled ripple would push settling to 9.2 ms against a 2.67 ms shortest pulse.

decisions.what: Floating-rail bias RESOLVED: 2 x 8.2 kohm = 16.4 kohm dropper
decisions.why: Gives 1.00 mA zener bias at 48 V minimum against worst-case 1.2 mA op-amp Iq, and 49 pct of the 0805 power rating at 57 V - fixes both levers of the earlier self-conflict at a cost of 0.7 pct of P_avail.

decisions.what: H2-DECISION-1 (P3-OPEN-7): charge-FET SOA cannot be closed by derivation
decisions.why: The P x Zth(j-c) method that closed the IRF640NS does NOT extend to the IRF5210S: the IRF640NS had a DC line to extrapolate toward, the IRF5210S has none. Three mitigations already closed off - bigger ballast barred by the window arithmetic, lower limit barred by the 0.170 A sustained draw, soft-start ramp delays the peak without reducing it. Recommendation: accept plus 1000-cycle bench validation; fallback an off-catalogue P-channel with a published DC line.

decisions.what: H2-DECISION-2 (P3-OPEN-12): HOLD the two Extended hysteresis values (820k bank UVLO, 620k bank ceiling)
decisions.why: No Basic E24 neighbour exists. Retargeting would spend 18 pct of the UVLO band - already the tightest and deliberately not widened - or take a 0.31 V bite out of the 8.3 V operating window, to save about 3 USD across the build. Sourcer correctly refused; confirming at H2 rather than silently.

decisions.what: P4 POLARITY TRAPS recorded: electrolytic symbol has no +/- cue (pad 1 = POSITIVE); MMSZ zeners pin1=CATHODE while SMBJ58A TVS pin1=ANODE in the same BOM
decisions.why: Librarian verified from symbol pin names and footprint silk. A reversed 100 V electrolytic on a charged 48 V bank is an energetic failure, and the opposite pin-1 conventions on two diode families in one BOM is a live reversal trap. Both must be stated explicitly to every P4 sheet agent.

decisions.what: fp_verify 6/6 effective: C23708's pad_count 3v4 AND pad_pitch 5.08v2.54 are ONE root cause (centre lead has no land), not two defects
decisions.why: D2PAK cropped centre lead means pads 1 and 3 sit two lead pitches apart, so nearest-neighbour pitch reads 5.08. Reconciled, not waived. C2622 IRF5210S reuses the same footprint file and the same 4=D/1=G/3=S map, so the trap covers 5 devices. Zero courtyard-less footprints across all 24.
